scope: Records of table tab01; provenance: direct source tab01

name: tab02
definition: 业务明细记录 Counterexample: 与 tab05 易混：两者均含 fld075 与 fld001，需按列域区分 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab02; provenance: direct source tab02

name: tab03
definition: 业务分类记录 Counterexample: 与 tab06 易混：两者均含 fld072，需确认 fld072 指向 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04
definition: 业务扩展记录 Counterexample: 与 tab02 易混：两者均含 fld049、fld070，需按列域与粒度区分 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: tab05
definition: 业务关联记录 Counterexample: 与 tab02 易混：两者均含 fld075，需确认 fld075 语义 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab05; provenance: direct source tab05

name: tab06
definition: 业务辅助记录 Counterexample: 与 tab03 易混：两者均含 fld072，需确认 fld072 指向 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab06; provenance: direct source tab06

name: Card
definition: A unique printing of a Magic card, identified by fld001.

name: CardName
definition: The printed name of a card.

name: BorderColor
definition: The border style/color of the card face.

name: BorderlessCard
definition: A card whose border is borderless.

name: Power
definition: The power value of a creature card; '*' or NULL means unknown/infinite.

name: UnknownPowerCard
definition: A card whose power is '*' or NULL.
scope: tab01 where fld055 = '*' OR fld055 IS NULL

name: InfinitePowerCard
definition: A card whose power is '*'.

name: PromotionalPrinting
definition: Flag indicating the card is a promotional printing.

name: FrameStyle
definition: The frame style of the card.

name: TextBoxFlag
definition: Flag indicating presence of a text box (0 = no text box).
aliases: do not have a text box

name: StorySpotlight
definition: Flag indicating the card is a Story Spotlight card.
scope: tab01 where fld001 IS NOT NULL AND fld034 IS NOT NULL

name: Foil
definition: Foil availability; powerful foil when both foil columns are non-null.
scope: tab01 where fld006 IS NOT NULL AND fld007 IS NOT NULL

name: Color
definition: The color identity letter of the card.

name: CardType
definition: The card type (e.g., Artifact).

name: Supertype
definition: The supertype of the card.
scope: tab01 where fld065 IS NOT NULL

name: Subtype
definition: The subtype of the card.
scope: tab01 where fld066 IS NOT NULL

name: CardSet
definition: The set/expansion the card belongs to.

name: Language
definition: The language of the card printing.

name: Translation
definition: A translated name for the card/set; non-null means a translation exists.
scope: tab05 where fld094 IS NOT NULL

name: FormatLegality
definition: Legality status of a card in a format.
aliases: formats in which these cards are legal

name: CommanderLegality
definition: Legality of a card in the Commander format.

name: BannedCard
definition: A card that is banned in some format.

name: Ruling
definition: A ruling entry associated with a card.

name: AvailabilityOutsideUS
definition: Flag indicating the card is only available outside the US.
aliases: only available outside the United States

name: TriggeredAbilityText
definition: Card text containing 'triggered ability'.
scope: tab01 where fld001 IS NOT NULL

name: BorderlessCardPercentage
definition: Share of cards that are borderless. Formula: BorderlessCard / Card * 100. Inputs: BorderlessCard = tab01.fld001 WHERE fld005 = 'borderless'; Card = tab01.fld001

name: ChineseSimplifiedCardPercentage
definition: Share of cards available in Simplified Chinese. Formula: COUNT(Card WHERE Language = 'Chinese Simplified') / Card * 100. Inputs: Card = tab01.fld001; Language = tab02.fld075 WHERE fld075 IN ('Italian','Chinese Simplified','German')
aliases: percentage of the cards available in Chinese Simplified

name: StorySpotlightNoTextBoxPercentage
definition: Share of Story Spotlight cards lacking a text box. Formula: COUNT(StorySpotlight WHERE TextBoxFlag = 0) / COUNT(StorySpotlight) * 100. Inputs: StorySpotlight = tab01.fld001 WHERE fld001 IS NOT NULL AND fld034 IS NOT NULL; TextBoxFlag = tab01.fld034 WHERE fld034 = 0
aliases: percentage of Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text
story spotlight no text box percentage

name: IncrediblyPowerfulCardPercentage
definition: Share of cards with powerful foils in a set. Formula: COUNT(Foil) / COUNT(Card) * 100. Inputs: Foil = tab01.fld006 WHERE fld006 IS NOT NULL AND fld007 IS NOT NULL; Card = tab01.fld001

name: UnknownPowerCardCount
definition: Number of cards with unknown/infinite power. Formula: COUNT(UnknownPowerCard). Inputs: UnknownPowerCard = tab01.fld001 WHERE fld055 = '*' OR fld055 IS NULL
aliases: how many cards have infinite power

name: InfinitePowerCardCount
definition: Number of cards with power '*'. Formula: COUNT(InfinitePowerCard). Inputs: InfinitePowerCard = tab01.fld001 WHERE fld055 = '*'
aliases: how many cards have infinite power

name: UnknownPowerTriggeredAbilityCount
definition: Number of unknown-power cards whose text mentions triggered ability. Formula: COUNT(UnknownPowerCard WHERE TriggeredAbilityText). Inputs: UnknownPowerCard = tab01.fld001 WHERE fld055 = '*' OR fld055 IS NULL; TriggeredAbilityText = tab01.fld001 WHERE fld001 IS NOT NULL
aliases: unknown power cards contain info about the triggered ability

name: MaxRulingCount
definition: Maximum number of rulings for any card. Formula: MAX(COUNT(Ruling) GROUP BY Card). Inputs: Ruling = tab06.fld072; Card = tab01.fld001

name: CardLegality
definition: Which formats a card is legal or banned in.

name: CardLanguage
definition: Languages in which card printings are available.

name: CardBorder
definition: Border styles of card faces.

name: CardColor
definition: Color identity letters of cards.

name: CardTypeTheme
definition: Card types such as Artifact, Creature, etc.
